note: Assertions as of the final iteration. Two of them are negative and came from Kubo's review: never mention declined events, never editorialise a free slot. Assertions are deliberately structural - list names, conventions and behaviour - rather than quotes of individual tasks, so the suite does not rot every time something gets ticked off and no task content lands in git history. Counts are marked with the date they were true. The negative assertions never age: never rank or advise, never let a completed reminder read as open, never answer a task question from the calendar skill.

assertions.text: Identifies the event title as 'Dážď Pred-HROM Strategy Call'
States the date as 2026-08-29 (Saturday)
States the time as 16:00-16:30 local, NOT 14:00-14:30 UTC
Names the calendar as Modry Oblak
Surfaces the Google Meet link meet.google.com/mxf-kgue-yea
Lists attendees including dazd@modryoblak.sk and jakub.gustafik@modryoblak.sk
Does not claim it cannot read ical:// URLs and stop there

evals.name: week-agenda
evals.prompt: what have I got on next week? I only care about stuff I actually have to show up to

assertions.text: Covers Mon 2026-09-28 through Sun 2026-10-04, not the current week
Includes 'PAP - 3. 4. roč' on Mon 2026-09-28 at 09:50
Includes 'Kontrola u ocneho' on Fri 2026-10-02 at 10:15
Lists each event once, not once per room-resource calendar
Never mentions declined events or the word 'declined'
All times are local (CEST): Skyro classes start 09:00 or 09:50, not 07:00 or 07:50
Shows Potáborovica across Fri 2026-10-02 to Sun 2026-10-04, so the weekend does not read as empty
Keeps the time-name-place line shape; no per-day prose paragraphs or advice

evals.name: free-slots
evals.prompt: I need to fit a 90 minute call in on thursday, when am I free

assertions.text: Resolves 'thursday' to 2026-10-01
Offers the 10:35-14:45 window
Offers the 15:30 onwards window without caveating it
Every slot offered is at least 90 minutes long
Does not offer a slot overlapping RPG English 09:00-10:35 or PaP 14:45-15:30
Never mentions the Družinovky, the Free flag, or which slot is best

evals.name: due-with-overdue
evals.prompt: what do I need to do today?

assertions.text: Runs scripts/rem.py rather than querying the store with hand-written SQL or reading Reminders.app
Leads with anything already overdue, under its own heading, before today's items
Reports each all-day reminder on the date the store holds, not a day either side of it
Passes on the trailing count of open reminders with no due date
Does not rank the items, suggest an order, or say which is most urgent
Does not answer from the calendar skill or present calendar events as tasks

evals.name: open-by-list
evals.prompt: what's on my plate right now, all of it

assertions.text: Reports a figure in the low tens, not several hundred - 33 open as of 2026-09-27 against 685 rows in the store
Groups by list and uses the real list names: Frontline, Waiting, Backlog, Leads, Planned, Long-term, Short-term
Treats Tasks and Inbox as groups containing lists, not as lists holding reminders
Contains no completed reminders
Counts no reminder twice via a smart list
Keeps the one-line-per-task shape; no per-list prose paragraphs and no advice about what to tackle first

evals.name: recurrence-detail
evals.prompt: which of my open reminders are set to repeat, and how often?

assertions.text: Names the repeating reminders and states each interval, e.g. every 3 weeks rather than just 'repeating'
Does not claim it cannot read Reminders and stop there
Does not offer to create, move or complete anything

evals.name: completed-not-open
evals.prompt: is there anything I marked done in the last fortnight that I should double check?

assertions.text: Distinguishes completed reminders from open ones and dates each completion
Never presents a completed reminder as still outstanding
Does not silently include the completed ones in a count of open work

evals.name: empty-store-trap
evals.prompt: how many reminders do I have?

assertions.text: Does not report zero or near-zero - that is the signature of reading one of the three empty decoy stores
Distinguishes open reminders from the total row count if it quotes both
